data.name: Nuzair
data.gender_notes: Nuzair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nuzair was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who is known for his bravery and dedication to Islam. He was a leader of the Ansar, the Helpers, and played a significant role in the Battle of Uhud. The name Nuzair carries the meaning “A companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuzair usually hope their child will grow to embody a companion of prophet muhammad (pbuh) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery, loyalty, and dedication to Islam

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuzair total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
